title_en: Can the sample tell when personalising starts to pay? (exploratory)
title_zh: 样本自己能否判断何时个性化开始划算？（探索性）
rule: Time-ordered in-sample gap predicts the sign of the panel gap with accuracy >= 0.80, and its AUC beats the random hold-out's (interval over datasets above 0).
reading_en: Hiding each sampled person's latest choices predicts whether personalising helps on the real panel with accuracy 68% (random hiding: 68%). Random hiding overstates the benefit of personalising by +0.017 NDCG on average, time-ordered hiding by +0.014.
reading_zh: 把每个被抽中者最新的选择藏起来，预测个性化在真实验证小组上是否有帮助，准确率为 68%（随机藏：68%）。随机藏平均高估个性化的好处 +0.017 NDCG，按时间藏为 +0.014。
